description: A React functional component named CompactActivityStream that displays recent activity data, including loading states, errors, and a list of recent executions with status icons, timestamps, and navigation features.

methods.name: getStatusVisuals
methods.description: Determines icon, theme, and label based on normalized execution status.

methods.name: handleExecutionClick
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a specific execution based on its ID.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string, such as 'ms', 's', or 'm s'.
